data.long_meaning: In Arabic, 'Mohtarma' means 'Lady of the Throne'. It is a title of respect and honor for a woman. The name Mohtarma carries the meaning “Lady of the Throne” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mohtarma usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of the throne and live with faith, good character and purpose.
